## ProgressWindowOptions.bodyClass property

Class name(s) added to the page's `body` element, alongside the `progress-window` class that is always present.

Use this for design systems that scope their tokens to a class such as `.theme-dark`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
bodyClass?: string;
```
